newsitem.title: USA: BPA offers 400 MW peak, firm power for Monday.
newsitem.headline: BPA offers 400 MW peak, firm power for Monday.

text.p: The Bonneville Power Administration (BPA) offered 400 megawatts (MW) of firm power during peak demand hours on Monday at $12.00 per megawatt hour (MWh) for Northwest delivery and at $13.00 for California-Oregon border (COB) sales, the agency said Friday.
BPA last offered peak firm power for Thursday delivery at $13.00-14.00 per MWh.
Offers of unlimited peak firm power during light load hours on Monday remained unchanged at $9.00 a MWh.
Monday non-firm power for hours ending 0100-0500 and 2400 was unchanged at $9.00 for all deliveries, while deliveries during hours ending 0600-0700 and 2300 were offered at $10.00.
Non-firm power during hours ending 0800-0900 on Monday was offered at $11.00-12.00.
BPA prices for firm power on Saturday and Sunday were the same as Monday's, as were non-firm off-peak prices.
Non-firm power during peak hours on Saturday was offered at $12.50-13.50, and at $11.50-12.50 on Sunday.
